resources.cardDescription: Free AI-powered parenting support for Murray families — voice assistant, lullabies, custom storybooks, and 24/7 guidance in 80+ languages.
A curated directory of free and low-cost family, parenting, and youth resources for Murray families — crisis support, parenting classes, food assistance, and more.
